title: Interior Design & Architecture Seeking Loan in Bengaluru, India
tagline: Design-led interiors and construction company providing end-to-end solutions across interior design, architectural design, and project execution for residential and commercial clients. - Offers interior design and execution projects typically valued at INR 15–40 lakh, architectural design and execution projects starting at INR 1 crore, and premium execution-only projects ranging from INR 50 lakh to INR 3 crore. - Has converted approximately INR 5 crore in business over the past five months, with 14 client projects currently in progress and seven additional projects in the pipeline. - Has set a target of INR 15 crore in business for the current financial year, supported by an existing client network and recent order growth. - Has achieved this initial business traction without active advertising or a dedicated sales team, primarily leveraging the promoter’s extensive professional network and industry relationships. - Plans to accelerate growth by introducing structured marketing initiatives and an in-house sales team, supported by a specialist marketing agency. - Also generates supplementary income through cross-selling selected products and earning associated incentives. - Engages contract employees for project execution as required. - The promoter brings approximately 13 years of industry experience across design, construction, and project execution. - The business was initially operated as a proprietorship and has recently transitioned into a private limited company (registered with the MCA), providing a corporate structure for its next phase of growth.
